<div class="card-body">
'''General Carlist Rieekan''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊カーリスト・ライカン将軍</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホスの同じ位置上にいる反乱軍はそれぞれ戦闘力＋１。１フォースを消費して「デス・スコードロン」をキャンセルできる。エコー基地の位置にいる場合、相手が「エコー基地の任務」をキャンセルするためにはホスの位置を１つ余分に滞在しなければならない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-General-Carlist-Rieekan-PSA-151452831.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱同盟軍の創設者の一人。かつて民間の戦術参謀としてオーガナ家の顧問を務めた。楽観論を戒めるエコー基地のリーダー。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' General Carlist Rieekan.

'''Card text:'''
Each Rebel at the same Hoth location is power +1. May use 1 Force to cancel Death Squadron. While at an Echo site, the opponent must occupy one extra Hoth site to cancel Echo Base Operations.

'''Lore:'''
One of the founders of the Rebel Alliance. A former civilian tactician who advised the House of Organa. The leader of Echo Base, who warns against optimism.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[General Carlist Rieekan]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
